title: Sean McDermott "going outside of football" to grow ahead of return to coaching

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McDermott "going outside of football" to grow ahead of return to coaching
sources.description: Sean McDermott did not take another coaching job after being fired by the Bills in the wake of their playoff loss to the Broncos and that's created more time for the routines of family life that he missed out on while he was the head coach in Buffalo.
